records.name: Simone
records.name_string_id_reason: The guide lists multiple locale-table name IDs; see name_string_ids.
title_or_role: Chef trainer; runs the Cobblestone Village Cafe. "If you can stand the heat, get in the kitchen and start cooking with Simone in Cobblestone Village!" (3799761246). Client text calls her "some human named Simone" who "bakes something called choc-o-late bread" (3614772560) and whose "pies were the best in these parts" (1204868364). One of the three Chef starts (128204835). Video dialog header "Simone" in the Farmer's Market list window (pjvw6oAT-zQ/00074).
location_evidence: At the cafe's cooking table, "to the north" (1322711683, 2118187567), "to the Northwest of here" (609555893), "north of Samantha" (3602865719). Wiki: Crossroads Cafe "Northwest of the center of town". One client line puts her "in Sanctuary" (293476933, see Conflicts 6).
quests_given_text: Chef: Cobblestone Village Cafe (unlocks the job; Spiralmint Steak), Chef: Delivery Derailed, and the Jonelle and Honey follow-ups (below). A cluster of client-only Simone titles on the Chef page: Chef: Assistant Needed, Chef: Anyone Can Cook!, Chef: Simone's Famous Spiralmint Steak, Chef: Preparation, Chef: Savory Goodness, Chef: Royally Large Order, Chef: A Sweet Treat. Simone's Shopping List (Farmer's Market customer order; video completion card "You receive 675 coins", pjvw6oAT-zQ/00078). An untitled ingredient pick-up: she sends the player to Bartle (800284964, 3432279268). Receives a recipe from Glerga to be returned (3564357491, Robgoblin Camp). Listed as a source in a fishing-teacher hook (3614772560, see Part F).

services: Cooking Table in front of her (1379080248, 2886930890); supplies the ingredients for two Spiralmint Steaks (2362971086). Farmer's Market customer entry "Farmer's Market - Simone" (ucdt 545047095, ugdt 1354120977). No recipe vendor known.
